summary.key_theme: ServiceNow 憑藉強勁的 AI 產品創新與穩定的企業需求，獲得多家券商上調目標價，儘管面臨估值與市場競爭的討論，但整體基本面展望正面。

bullish.title: Argus Research Maintains Buy on ServiceNow, Raises Price Target to $170
bullish.reason: Argus Research 將目標價從 134 美元大幅上調至 170 美元，顯示對公司成長潛力的強烈信心。

bullish.title: ServiceNow demand trends show improvement as UBS raises price target
bullish.reason: UBS 指出 ServiceNow 第三季需求趨勢穩定且有所改善，並上調目標價，為財報前夕注入強心針。

bullish.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Puts India At The Center Of New AI Workflow Tools
bullish.reason: 推出 AI Workflow Factory 與 Autonomous Engineer 等新產品，強化 AI 產品線競爭力。

bullish.title: Raleigh, North Carolina, reduces IT service desk costs by 66% with ServiceNow AI agents
bullish.reason: 具體數據顯示客戶透過 ServiceNow AI 代理成功降低 66% 成本，證明產品實際投資報酬率。

bullish.title: Bundesliga resolves 89 percent of fan questions at first contact with ServiceNow CRM
bullish.reason: 德國足球甲級聯賽採用 ServiceNow CRM，展現公司在大型企業與組織中的市場滲透力。

bullish.title: Core6 Announces Partnership with Armis from ServiceNow to Extend Cyber Exposure Management
bullish.reason: 透過與 Core6 合作，擴展在網路安全與數據基礎設施的影響力。

bearish.title: NOW is Overvalued at 28.92X P/E: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
bearish.reason: 指出 28.92 倍的本益比過高，且年初至今股價已下跌 24.6%，反映市場對高估值的擔憂。

bearish.title: ServiceNow Stock And Other Cloud Software Names With Real AI Revenue Exposure
bearish.reason: 提到 AI 熱潮面臨現實檢視，市場對雲端軟體公司的 AI 營收貢獻持審慎態度。

neutral.title: ServiceNow vs. Palantir: Can Faster AI Growth Justify Paying More Than Four Times as Much for Cash Flow?
neutral.reason: 將 ServiceNow 與 Palantir 進行比較，探討 AI 成長與現金流估值的合理性，屬中性分析。

neutral.title: Work4Flow Launches 90-Day Program to Accelerate Salesforce-to-ServiceNow CRM Migration
neutral.reason: 第三方機構推出的遷移服務，雖有利於 ServiceNow 獲客，但屬於生態系中的常規業務活動。

neutral.title: CrowdStrike vs. ServiceNow: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
neutral.reason: 對比兩家科技股的投資價值，未提供明確買賣建議，僅供投資人參考。
